item.title: Teenager built homemade radar to find buried bulls on grandfather’s farm; now Australian ‘Grave Hunter’ has uncovered more than 600 lost graves
item.description: Known for his remarkable work, Dave Hunter—'Dave the Grave Hunter'—has made a significant discovery of 658 unmarked graves throughout Australia. His company, Hunter Geophysics, employed ground-penetrating radar to meticulously complete the project in 2026, all while maintaining the integrity of existing cemeteries. Local councils are keen to safeguard these findings and attach stories to each grave. Future endeavors may also reach out to nearby areas grappling with identical predicaments. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
item.description: US negotiators have floated the idea of Ukraine’s potential withdrawal from its eastern region of Donbas in exchange for joining Nato, President Volodymyr Zelensky said, following the latest round of peace talks with Russia in Abu Dhabi. This is the first time the question of linking Nato membership to territorial concessions has been raised during the talks, Zelensky said in remarks ‌to reporters released by his office on Saturday. “The Americans raised a question: ‘What if Ukraine joins Nato?... Publicado también por: South China Morning Post, ABC News Australia, The Jerusalem Post - International, CNBC - World. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: Pat Cummins’ $905,000 Moss Vale investment bought in 2017 sells for $1.16 million after eight months
item.description: Australian cricket captain Pat Cummins and wife Rebecca have sold their Moss Vale investment property for an estimated $1.16 million after eight months on the market. The couple bought the 1920s three-bedroom bungalow for $905,000 in 2017. Previously rented for around $550 a week, the property sits on a sprawling 2,327-square-metre block in the Southern Highlands. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
